title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Retiring GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark & Pausing Pro Subscriptions: OpenAI announced plans to retire the GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark model next week while maintaining a signup pause on $200 Pro plans to manage inference load on new frontier models.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Architecture Released: DeepSeek introduced V4.1 Flash featuring a 552B MoE backbone with 196B conditional memory parameters, boasting 33x to 133x lower inference costs compared to competing models.

Anthropic Exposes Security Risks of LLM API Relays: Security reports highlighted major risks from unencrypted Chinese LLM proxy/relay services leaking corporate codebase tokens, cloud API keys, and internal prompt data.

Apple Reportedly Paying Samsung $250/Screen for iPhone Duo OLEDs: Industry reports indicate Apple is sourcing foldable OLED displays from Samsung for the upcoming iPhone Duo at $250 per display module.

UEFA Champions League Kickoff & Ballon d'Or Speculation: Bayern Munich extended their historic 39-game home unbeaten streak in Champions League group/league play as Declan Rice and Vincent Kompany backed Harry Kane and Michael Olise for Ballon d'Or contention.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Retiring GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark & Managing Pro Plan Capacity
items.body: OpenAI engineer Tibo Sottiaux announced the retirement of GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark next week to free up server infrastructure, following the recent subscription pause on $200 Pro plans.

items.title: @onusoz: DeepSeek Unveils V4.1 Flash with Engram Conditional Memory
items.body: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash featuring 16B active parameters out of 552B MoE total and a 4x smaller KV cache, drastically reducing token costs by two orders of magnitude.

items.title: @lidangzzz & @jessyshen: Security Alarm Over LLM API Relay Data Leaks
items.body: Industry commentary centered on security findings showing commercial API proxy relay services leaking confidential codebase tokens, cloud credentials, and internal AI queries.

items.title: @tldraw: tldraw Responds to OpenAI's New @Sketch Feature
items.body: Canvas tool tldraw challenged OpenAI's newly announced @Sketch drawing capability inside ChatGPT, offering live visual prototyping alternatives.

items.title: @poteto: Grok Android App Enters Google Play Pre-Registration
items.body: The Grok team announced their Android companion application is nearing launch, opening pre-registration for users on the Google Play Store.

items.title: @ErfanEbrahimnia: Shopify Shifts Mobile Architecture Back to Native
items.body: Developer discussions highlighted Shopify's strategic shift moving core app infrastructure away from React Native in favor of native platform frameworks.

items.title: @trq212: Context-Building Prompting Technique for LLM Memory
items.body: A viral prompt pattern suggests leveraging interactive interview mode to build comprehensive long-term context profiles within Claude and ChatGPT.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Apple Sourcing Samsung Foldable OLED Displays for iPhone Duo
items.body: Reports surfaced that Apple will pay Samsung $250 per unit for foldable OLED screens intended for the anticipated iPhone Duo launch.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: US Inflation Holds Steady at 3.4%
items.body: Bureau of Labor Statistics data confirmed US CPI inflation remained at 3.4% year-over-year, keeping macroeconomic monetary policy expectations unchanged.

items.title: @theo: High Sentiment Surrounds Current Y Combinator Batch
items.body: Y Combinator community discussions noted the current YC startup cohort is among the highest quality and most undervalued in recent history.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano & @TouchlineX: UEFA UCL Team of the Week & Ballon d'Or Criteria
items.body: UEFA released the Team of the Week following Champions League Matchday 1, while official Ballon d'Or voting guidelines emphasizing individual performance and team success were highlighted.

items.title: @FCBayernEN & @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Munich Extends 39-Game Unbeaten UCL Home Streak
items.body: Bayern Munich maintained their record 39-match unbeaten streak in home UCL group/league matches as Vincent Kompany publicly supported Harry Kane and Michael Olise for Ballon d'Or recognition.

items.title: @NOT_MOTD & @CFC_Janty: Michael Olise Post-Match Demeanor Sparks Fan Debate
items.body: Michael Olise's calm and reserved post-match interview style triggered widespread debate across football media and fan communities.
